criteria.description: Recurring high-cost professional decision problem with identifiable budget owners
Cadence supports recurrent monitoring rather than one-off content consumption
Credible lawful commercial-reuse path with source-specific review still required
Stable official API, bulk data or machine-readable access path
Material claims can be represented atomically and admitted deterministically
Geographic, relational and temporal structure advances the canonical product
Structured history and evidence provide defensibility beyond generic search or chat
Initial operation is compatible with public data, deterministic transforms and premium margins
Value can be delivered as observation and research without advice, execution or custody

required: No personalised investment recommendation is required for the core workflow
No unauthorised scraping or redistribution is required
At least one official source can support a bounded technical probe
The universe can be disabled independently

candidates.name: European public procurement intelligence
candidates.rationale: TED provides open machine access to published notices, bulk-reuse paths and an official procurement ontology. The universe supports recurring discovery, buyer and award graphs, geographic demand, deadlines, values and historical patterns without requiring transaction execution or personalised investment advice.

official_evidence.title: TED Open Data Search API reuse

candidates.name: European grants and non-dilutive capital
candidates.rationale: Commercial value is strong, but call, programme, award and national-source access is more fragmented. It remains the first adjacent expansion after a source-by-source machine-access and rights review.

official_evidence.title: European Commission funding and tender eligibility

candidates.name: EU regulation-created business demand
candidates.rationale: Official legal data and strong differentiation exist, but translating a legal obligation into economic demand requires a bounded inference ontology, jurisdictional review and explicit non-authoritative proposal handling.

official_evidence.title: EUR-Lex content reuse and Cellar access

candidates.name: Public-company strategic disclosures
candidates.rationale: EDGAR offers excellent official machine access and deterministic facts, but the initial workflow is closer to established financial-data products and carries a more sensitive investment-information boundary.

candidates.name: European trade and supply-chain shifts
candidates.rationale: Comext is a strong official source and the universe fits Globe, Graph and Timeline. It is retained as the first context layer for procurement, but opportunity interpretation requires more aggregation, entity mapping and costly high-volume processing.

official_evidence.title: Eurostat international trade in goods information

candidates.name: Macroeconomic and sovereign opportunity context
candidates.rationale: Official APIs and claim quality are excellent, but macro data alone does not create a sufficiently differentiated recurring commercial workflow. It remains a mandatory context layer rather than the wedge.

candidates.name: European real assets and property
candidates.rationale: Buyer value and visual fit are strong, but cross-border source rights, listing access, transaction comparability and official machine coverage are too fragmented for the first lawful universe.

selected_universe.implementation_scope: TED notices and awards with official macro and trade context only after independent source admission
initial_buyer_scope: European SMEs and growth operators evaluating public-sector demand
Holdings, venture studios and corporate-development teams mapping demand and competitors
Professional research users monitoring procurement-driven market change
selected_universe.first_high_value_workflow: Discover and investigate newly published European procurement demand by geography, CPV sector, buyer, value band and deadline; inspect evidence, changes, award history, contradictions and missing coverage; save a monitored investigation trail.
authoritative_claim_classes: OBSERVED buyer, procedure, lot, CPV, place of performance, deadline and stated value
OBSERVED award, winner and stated award value when published
CALCULATED time remaining and currency-normalised value with reproducible inputs
CALCULATED recurrence and concentration measures from admitted historical notices
non_authoritative_or_prohibited: Supplier suitability or probability of winning
Automatic interpretation that a tender is profitable
Bid submission, transaction execution or representation
Canonical claims derived from personal contact data
Any source or field without a source-specific rights record

explicitly_not_authorised: Publicly claim that European procurement is supported
Ingest national portals without separate source admission
Add grants, regulation, filings or property as simultaneous launch universes
Create model authority over canonical procurement claims
Activate billing or entitlements based on this selection alone
